Critical structural note for whoever resumes: Claude's own browser automation tab runs backgrounded (document.hidden: true) which throttles rAF/setTimeout so severely that real-time animation behavior cannot be reliably observed there — verification this session relied on direct engine-state inspection via temporary window-exposed debug hooks, fake-clock patching of performance.now(), and forced synthetic event dispatch (mousedown/mousemove/mouseup/pointerdown etc.) rather than literally watching it animate. Also hit the same test-methodology trap twice: Embla's settled()/offsetLocation is only updated inside its render() step, not seek() — pumping seek() alone without also simulating the alpha-interpolation step gives false 'frozen' readings that look exactly like real bugs. Any resuming agent testing settled()-dependent logic must simulate the full update+render cycle, not just seek().
